title: Python Node delivers signed frames addressed to other nodes
description: LinkLayer.receive authenticates and returns any known peer's signed frame without destination filtering. Node._process_received immediately delivers non-SCHC/non-fragment payloads to on_receive, so an Extended unicast addressed to another node is accepted locally; SCHC single-frame and other paths also rely on later partial checks. Rust filters wire_is_for_local before admission. Add one canonical local-target gate covering NONE broadcast, Extended EUI-64, configured SHORT, and ELIDED IPv6 destination before application/routing mutation; wrong-target frames must not deliver, allocate protocol state, or emit responses. Add multi-node overhearing tests for raw, single-frame SCHC, RPL, and fragments.
